purpose: Bounded summary generation and persistent cache correctness across four CLI model loads
limits: One tiny file, one model and four invocations establish only narrow cache/generation behavior.
The initial v1 summary named the correct return value but incorrectly claimed bodies were absent; it is not a successful quality trial.
The declared model identity was externally checked for this trial. The runtime API trusts that host assertion.
CLI cache hits still load the model. Their zero generation work is not zero end-to-end cost.
Timings are one-run observations, overlap and have coarse Windows resolution; no speedup or confidence interval is claimed.
The harness edited fixture files between invocations; the summarize command performed no source mutation, tool or validation command.
No Linux CUDA or macOS Metal inference or agent context-summary selection is established.
